newsitem.title: USA: Nalco realizes small gain on unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Nalco realizes small gain on unit sale.

text.p: Nalco Chemical Co said on Monday that it realized a small gain from the now completed sale of its super-absorbent chemicals business to Stockhausen GmbH KG, a subsidiary of Huls AG.
However, full terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Announced last June, the sale includes Nalco's super-absorbent chemicals business, as well as the company's super-absorbent manufacturing facility in Garyville, La. Stockhausen has offered jobs to employees associated with the business.
Nalco, a specialty chemicals maker, said the business no longer fit its strategy.
